Description:
**Job Title:** Director of Development

**Department:** Administration

**Reports To:** Chief Executive Officer

**FLSA Status:** Exempt, Full\-time

**Salary Range (D2\):** $110,000\+ per year


The Sacramento SPCA is a vibrant, well\-established and respected non\-profit animal welfare organization. Through our nationally ranked high\-volume spay and neuter clinic (we are ranked as one of the top 10 clinics in the country!), successful adoption program, behavior and training programs and commitment to excellent animal care, the Sacramento SPCA is giving more than shelter and saving animals, one life at a time.

**Position Summary:**


The Director of Development is responsible for all fundraising initiatives and activities of the organization. They are directly responsible for the meeting of fundraising goals for the Sacramento SPCA. While they may develop more and innovative programs for this income, the basic means for fundraising should include: major gift cultivation, capital campaigns as needed, bequests, guardian program, direct mail, grants, events, and membership. Additionally, the Director of Development should cultivate and maintain relationships with the new and existing donors and supporters.


As a member of the senior management team, the Director of Development participates in strategic planning and budgeting initiatives in addition to problem solving. They work within the guidelines, policies and mission of the organization and will be accountable and responsible for specific projects as assigned.

**Essential Job Functions:**

* In this role, all decisions should be made by balancing the welfare of the organization, the staff, and the animals we serve.
* Works productively and cooperatively with Senior Team to maintain vision, core values, and focus on strategic plan
* Direct the implementation of all agency fundraising activities.
* Supervise and ensure the coordination within the department of: Events Manager, Events Coordinator, Development Data Coordinator, Development Communication Manager, and Development Assistant.
* Cultivate and nurture relationships with current and potential donors and corporate/foundation supporters.
* Identify potential grant opportunities and supervise grant proposals to ensure that they align with organization goals
* Develop and grow our individual donor base; manage annual giving; cultivate major gifts.
* Supervise quality control and capacity of data maintained by the fundraising office (Raiser’s Edge and Blackbaud).
* Develop and implement direct\-mail appeals, planned giving program, major gift campaigns, all on\-going revenue generating programs, and grant applications.
* Supervise, train, evaluate, and counsel all direct reports.
* Work closely with the Director of Communications and Marketing to facilitate fundraising public relations program through news releases, public service announcements, community bulletins, personal contacts, special features, lectures and media interviews to support the fundraising department. Work together on marketing pieces to support special events and development.
* Committed to the development of direct reports.
* Supervise and coordinate successful annual events including: Gala, Doggy Dash, Big Day of Giving.
* Must have strong communications skills, including writing and editing experience.
* As needed, provide reports to the Board of Directors.
* Responsible for forecasting, planning, and troubleshooting within their department and being aware of trends in the market and shelter.
* Supervise expenditures within approved budgetary limits as related to development, membership and fundraising activities.

**Additional Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Present fundraising, membership development and grant opportunities to the CEO and to the Board of Directors and assist in the coordination of those activities within the guidelines of SSPCA policy.
* Assist the Board of Directors and the CEO in building up the membership base of the Society by actively soliciting new members to the SSPCA and stewarding current members and major donors.
* Regularly conduct and participate in meeting with other members of the senior staff to share ideas and suggestions designed to improve working conditions and the programs of the SSPCA.
* Submit an annual development plan for consideration and prepare periodic reports.
* Ability to get along and work effectively with the public, management, fellow employees, volunteers, and other agencies and groups. Shows respect to others and values staff contributions.


Requirements:
**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:**

* Excellent communications, public relations, supervisory and written skills.
* Ability to get along and work effectively with the public, management, fellow employees, volunteers, and other agencies and groups.
* Proven management and leadership capabilities.
* Good computer skills and knowledge of programs such as Word, Excel or similar programs.
* Knowledge of data collection systems (e.g. Raiser’s Edge and Blackbaud).
* Experience in working with governmental agencies, community groups, volunteers and animal welfare organizations a plus.
* Demonstrated capability to be a self\-starter, facilitator, organizer and innovator.
* Ability to plan and implement projects with little supervision and must be able to work independently.

**Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Business Administration or related field.
* Five years of related experience in fundraising, membership development and special events with specific knowledge and proven ability in planned giving, membership development, corporate and foundation solicitation, and major gifts.
* Capital campaign experience preferred.
* Nonprofit management degree or Certified Fund Raising Executive (CFRE) accreditation
* Minimum of five years’ experience in development with demonstrated success, preferably in the not\-for\-profit sector.

**The Organization**

El Centro de Amistad (ECDA) is a community\-based behavioral health organization serving children, adults, and families throughout the San Fernando Valley. ECDA is committed to providing accessible, culturally responsive services to Latino, immigrant, low\-income, and other historically underserved communities.

**Position Opportunity Summary**

El Centro de Amistad seeks an experienced and mission\-driven Executive Director to provide strategic, operational, financial, and organizational leadership.

Reporting to the Board of Directors, the Executive Director serves as ECDA’s chief executive officer and is responsible for advancing the organization’s mission, implementing its new strategic plan, ensuring the quality and sustainability of its programs, and supporting a strong and effective staff.

The successful candidate will be a visible, accessible, and accountable leader who develops strong relationships with staff, the Board, public agencies, funders, and community partners.

**Key Role and Responsibilities**

*Strategic Leadership and Organizational Management*

* Partner with the Board and senior leadership team to implement ECDA’s strategic plan, establish organizational priorities, and ensure long\-term sustainability.
* Identify emerging community needs, organizational risks, funding opportunities, and opportunities for responsible growth.
* Lead organizational planning, change management, and continuous improvement while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, transparency, and inclusion.
* Establish clear organizational performance measures and regularly report financial, program, compliance, and strategic plan progress to the Board.

* Oversee contract deliverables, billing, reimbursement, documentation, and reporting.
* Work with clinical, financial, compliance, and program leaders to identify and address organizational risks.
* Maintain effective relationships with public agencies, funders, regulators, and referral partners.

*Leadership and Community Engagement*

* Recruit, develop, support, and evaluate the senior leadership team while strengthening organizational culture, staff development, succession planning, and employee engagement.
* Partner closely with the Board to support governance, fundraising, and strategic decision\-making.
* Serve as ECDA’s primary ambassador, building strong relationships with donors, funders, public agencies, community organizations, and other stakeholders to advance the organization’s mission and impact.

jobs.title: Vice President of Development
jobs.description:
Project Access is transforming lives in affordable housing communities across America. With over 120 Resource Centers in 17 states and a team of 145\+ dedicated professionals, we connect, engage, and empower more than 27,000 children, families, and seniors each year through four key initiatives:

* **Economic Stability** – Building pathways to financial independence
* **Education for Youth \& Families** – Creating opportunities for lifelong learning
* **Health \& Wellness** – Promoting healthy, thriving communities
* **Community Building** – Fostering connections that strengthen neighborhoods


We're not just providing services \- we're creating tangible, life\-changing impact in communities nationwide. See our success stories at www.project\-access.org/success\-stories.

**The Opportunity:**


Project Access is seeking a Vice President of Development to lead the next chapter of growth for our national fundraising operation. Working in close partnership with the CEO \& President, the VP of Development will be responsible for achieving ambitious strategic fund development goals as our organization continues to expand, with a $1\.8M annual fundraising target spanning corporate giving, grants, individual giving, special events, and campaigns.


This is an opportunity for a self\-directed, strategic thinker who thrives operating independently and can move fluidly between big\-picture vision and hands\-on execution. You'll act as both a doer and a thought leader, driving measurable revenue growth across a diversified funding portfolio that includes an 80% fee\-for\-service model through developers and 20% traditional fundraising, within a $13M operating model.


In this role, you will lead a focused turnaround and growth strategy, prioritizing:

* Improving national gift opportunities and grant success rates
* Rebuilding momentum in corporate giving
* Reengaging lapsed donors
* Growing and developing the development department
* Reestablishing and strengthening our brand


If you're energized by the challenge of building something bigger, and want your strategic vision to directly shape the future of an organization making a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.

**What you'll do**

**Lead \& Develop Our Team**

* Lead, coach, and develop a team of four direct reports: the Annual Giving Manager, Director of Community Relations, Director of Marketing and Communications, and Volunteer \& Community Partnerships Manager
* In your first 30 days, assess the department's strengths and needs and build a scalable revenue infrastructure
* Foster a culture of accountability, trust, and continuous improvement through regular coaching and clear goal\-setting
* Model collaborative leadership by working across departments and building strong partnerships with Operations, Programs, and Finance

**Drive Revenue Growth**

* Own strategic oversight of all revenue streams — individual gifts, events, foundation and government grants, corporate giving, CRA partnerships, planned giving, bequests, and endowments
* Develop and execute a donor roadmap, including a 90\-day revenue recovery plan and a three\-year growth strategy with defined milestones
* Segment and reengage lapsed donors, and pursue larger transformational gifts
* Build a major gifts program from the ground up, targeting 15\-20 new major donors annually ($5K\+ capacity)
* Launch a monthly giving program and reinstate our Planned Giving Program
* Create a donor recognition society with tiered recognition and exclusive cultivation events
* Support Board Give/Get fulfillment and cultivation, lead in\-kind contribution strategy, and partner with our technology team to grow PA Connect app licensing and enterprise revenue
* Ensure our CRM and donor database are set up to support our success, and oversee giving history and statistical reporting

**Overhaul Grant Strategy**

* Shift toward fewer, higher\-probability grant applications and build a 6\-month grant pipeline
* Develop compelling, funder\-specific case statements around affordable housing, digital equity, and resident services
* Prioritize multi\-year grant commitments to build sustainable revenue

**Rebuild Corporate Giving**

* Design a year\-round corporate engagement strategy with tiered partnership packages
* Audit existing relationships and re\-engage lapsed or reduced corporate donors
* Grow the Adopt\-A\-Center program and secure event sponsorships

**Elevate Our Brand**

* Develop and execute a national brand and marketing strategy that positions Project Access as the leader in embedded resident services within affordable housing
* Oversee marketing and communications to ensure consistent, compelling storytelling across all 17 states
* Serve as a spokesperson and advocate, raising Project Access's public profile

**Steward Our Donors**

* Lead a year\-round stewardship program focused on relationship\-building, not transactional asks
* Lead our signature annual campaigns, including Spread the Joy, and develop event committees to secure sponsorships and attendees

**Engage Our Board \& Volunteers**

* Equip and motivate the Board to identify, cultivate, and solicit donors, driving toward 100% Board giving participation
* Oversee volunteer strategy, ensuring volunteers are effectively recruited and deployed to support fundraising goals

**Provide Strategic Leadership**

* Translate organizational goals into actionable fundraising plans with clear accountability metrics
* Own key performance metrics: 75%\+ donor retention, 25\-30% grant success rate, 85%\+ corporate renewal rate, and 4:1 minimum ROI on events
* Oversee development budget lines and participate in the annual budget process
* Collaborate on annual reports and donor\-facing communications that showcase our impact

**Who you are**

**Essential Experience**

* 7\-10 years of progressive professional fundraising experience with demonstrated success across grants, corporate, major gifts, and events
* 5\+ years managing development

Founded in 1894, The Ebell of Los Angeles is one of the nation's oldest and largest women's organizations and one of Southern California's most distinctive cultural institutions. For more than 130 years, The Ebell has championed education, the arts, civic engagement, and the advancement of women.  

  

 Today, The Ebell serves as a vibrant center for arts, ideas, education, and civic dialogue, presenting hundreds of performances, conversations, educational programs, exhibitions, and community events each year from its iconic Wilshire campus, including the historic 1,270\-seat Ebell Theatre.  

  

 As The Ebell approaches the Centennial of its historic campus, the organization is entering an exciting period of growth—expanding audiences, strengthening earned and contributed revenue, investing in technology and infrastructure, and building a bold vision for its second century.

**Position Summary**
--------------------


The Director of Marketing \& Communications is a member of The Ebell's Senior Leadership Team and reports directly to the Chief Executive Officer.

The Director’s direct reports are a full\-time Graphic Designer and a part\-time Marketing Assistant.  The Director oversees marketing, communications, public relations, digital strategy, audience development, content creation, advertising, creative services, media relations, and institutional storytelling while partnering across Programming, Development, Membership, Private Events, Education, Finance, Operations, and Executive Leadership.  

  

 As The Ebell prepares for the Centennial of its historic campus, the Director will lead brand strategy and communications that celebrate the organization's remarkable legacy while positioning it for its next century of impact.

------------------------------

* Serve as a member of the Senior Leadership Team, contributing to organizational strategy and institutional planning.

The Branch Executive Director oversees the operation of the Y and participates in volunteer and staff development, financial development, and collaboration with community stakeholders.

Join a Legacy of Hope and Empowerment at Covenant House New York!

  

For over 50 years, Covenant House New York (CHNY) has been at the forefront of transforming lives by providing comprehensive shelter, housing, and wrap\-around support services for vulnerable homeless, runaway, and exploited youth. As the largest provider of these essential services in New York City, CHNY impacts the lives of over 1,500 young people aged 16\-24 every year.

Our ultimate goal is to provide a safe refuge and empower young people to build a brighter future founded on compassion, unconditional love, and absolute respect.

jobs.title: Executive Director
jobs.description:
**Overview**

Experience Burlington is a growing community of member businesses and nonprofit organizations serving the greater Burlington region. The Executive Director leads the organization and serves as its principal representative to the institutions that shape the local business climate — the City of Burlington, the Town of Burlington, Racine County, the Burlington Area School District, and the region’s largest employers.

This role has been structured so that the Executive Director’s primary focus is external: building relationships, advocating for the business community, and positioning Experience Burlington as an essential partner in regional growth. Internally, the Executive Director serves as chief administrative officer with full responsibility for finances, staff, and organizational strategy, while day\-to\-day events, membership engagement, and marketing are delegated to staff under the Executive Director’s oversight.

The position calls for a professional who is equally comfortable representing the organization at a council meeting, in a superintendent’s office, or across the table from a major employer, and who can then return to the office and manage a budget, evaluate program performance, and develop staff. Self\-motivation, poise, sound judgment, and political skill are essential, as are strong critical thinking, excellent written and verbal communication, and the ability to build consensus among parties who do not always begin in agreement.

**Primary Accountabilities Government, Institutional \& Business Relations** *(primary focus)*

* Serves as the principal representative and spokesperson for Experience Burlington to the City of Burlington, the Town of Burlington, Racine County, the Burlington Area School District, major employers, and other regional institutions.
* Chairs and convenes the Building Burlington Leadership Council, the region’s cross\-sector leadership table bringing together major employers, the City of Burlington, the Town of Burlington, the Burlington Area School District, and Experience Burlington. Sets the agenda, facilitates meetings, and drives shared priorities to actionable outcomes.
* Attends City and Town Council meetings, committee meetings, and public hearings as needed; monitors policy, zoning, development, and infrastructure decisions affecting member businesses and reports material developments to the Board.
* Builds and maintains working relationships with elected officials, municipal and county administrators, and department heads, including the Police Department, Department of Public Works, and Fire and EMS.
* Cultivates relationships with the region’s largest employers and anchor institutions, positioning Experience Burlington as a partner in workforce, investment, and community development priorities.
* Partners with school district leadership on workforce development, career exposure, and business–education initiatives.
* Represents Experience Burlington in economic development, tourism, downtown revitalization, and related regional efforts, and coordinates with county, regional, and state organizations where member interests are at stake.
* Advises the Board on public policy matters affecting the business community and advocates member positions once adopted by the Board.
* Leads major fund development, including anchor sponsorships, corporate partnerships, grants, and public funding opportunities.

**Organizational Leadership \& Administration**

* Serves as chief administrative officer, accountable to the Board of Directors for the performance of the organization.
* Manages the organization within the framework of a Board\-approved budget, including managing income and expenses to achieve annual net income goals and approving all financial disbursements.
* Supports the Board and Executive Committee by preparing meeting materials, financial reporting, and recommendations, and by setting agendas in coordination with the Board Chair.
* Leads strategic planning and long\-range organizational development in partnership with the Board.
* Directly manages office staff, including hiring, payroll, scheduling, performance feedback, annual performance reviews, and professional development.
* Provides general supervision over work performed by volunteers, contractors, and vendors.
* Oversees all aspects of office operations, including vendor and contract management, insurance, records, and organizational compliance.
* Conducts strategic analysis of programs, events, and operations, evaluating profitability, cost\-benefit, mission alignment, and member value, and makes recommendations to the Board accordingly.

**Oversight of Events, Membership \& Marketing**

*The Executive Director sets direction, approves plans and budgets, and holds staff accountable for results in these areas. Day\-to\-day planning and execution are delegated.*

* Approves the annual master event calendar and individual event budgets; staff are responsible for scheduling, logistics, volunteer recruitment, sponsorship solicitation, and execution.
* Sets membership recruitment and retention goals and reviews performance against them; personally engages prospective anchor members and at\-risk high\-value accounts.
* Approves the Master Marketing Plan and reviews campaign performance against defined metrics; staff are responsible for development, implementation, and reporting.
* Oversees the organization’s website and social media presence, with content and channel management delegated to staff.
* Ensures member value is assessed on a regular cycle and that new ideas and initiatives are generated in response to member expectations and interests.
* Serves as brand ambassador for Experience Burlington throughout the business and nonprofit community.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Serves as an active member of applicable community organizations.
* Establishes customer service standards for members and the general public and personally handles escalated member concerns.

About NAMI Nebraska

At NAMI Nebraska, we believe no one has to face mental illness alone. We're the state's grassroots home for anyone whose life has been touched by mental illness – the person navigating their own diagnosis, and everyone who loves them. Our programs are peer\-led, evidence\-based, and free to everyone who needs them. We're a small, growing organization building our philanthropy program, and this is a meaningful season to join us.

The Role

We're looking for an entrepreneurial, relationship\-driven Director of Development to lead all fundraising for NAMI Nebraska statewide. This is our chief fundraising role – someone energized by building relationships and making the ask, ready to grow a development program that already has a solid foundation in place. You'll also bring genuine care for the details: accurate records and consistent follow\-through matter here just as much as new relationships.

What You'll Do

* Develop and execute NAMI Nebraska's fundraising strategy, and meet annual goals set with the Executive Director and Board
* Build and execute a grants plan – identification, cultivation, writing, and stewardship – in partnership with the executive team
* Carry a personal portfolio of major and planned\-gift donors; cultivate, solicit, and steward them through personal calls and visits
* Oversee all fundraising outreach, communications, and events statewide
* Supervise and mentor a part\-time development staff member focused on events and sponsorships
* Support the Executive Director with his own portfolio of key donors and stakeholders
* Maintain accurate donor and gift records in Bloomerang
* Serve as a member of the executive team and help build a healthy, collaborative team culture

What We're Looking For

* Several years of nonprofit fundraising experience, ideally including major gifts and/or planned giving – or a strong track record of quickly learning and excelling in a new role
* A genuine relationship\-builder who's comfortable making the ask and closing the gift, not just cultivating
* Detail\-oriented – keeps donor records and follow\-up accurate and current
* Comfortable in a small, growing nonprofit – flexible, adaptable, and ready to wear multiple hats
* Working knowledge of CRM/donor database software (Bloomerang experience a plus)
* Reliable personal transportation and willingness to travel in\-state; availability for some evenings and weekends

Compensation \& Benefits

* $65,000\-$70,000 commensurate with experience
* Health insurance stipend and retirement match
* Full\-time, exempt, with a genuinely flexible schedule and a supportive, cooperative team culture

*NAMI Nebraska is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and are committed to building a team that reflects the diverse communities we serve across the state.*

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Lincoln, NE 68507

**OVERVIEW**

Nestled in the peaceful foothills of West Virginia, EdenSpring's mission is to create an oasis of safety for healing and restoration of adult female survivors of sex trafficking. As we prepare to open our doors and transition from building a structural home to cultivating a sacred sanctuary, we are seeking a mission\-driven **Program Director** who will exhibit and model our core pillars—**Love First, Offer Grace, Value Excellence, Exercise Integrity, and Walk Together**—this leader will serve as a shepherd to our program, our personnel, and our future residents. If you are ready to combine professional clinical excellence with an authentic calling to walk alongside courageous women on their journey to joy and independence, we invite you to step into this transformative leadership role

This program is great for a candidate who is vocationally called to:

* **Inaugural Leadership Impact:** As our first Program Director, this candidate will help shape the programmatic culture and operational foundation from the ground up, turning research\-backed, trauma and survivor\-informed practices into a whole person focused, wrap\-around program that results in life transformation and new beginnings.
* **Holistic, Full\-Circle Care Continuum:** Instead of short\-term crisis management, this candidate will oversee an up\-to\-two\-year residential journey that offers rent\-free housing integrated with counseling, education, spirituality, medical, legal, and life skills training.
* **Values\-First Work Environment:** You will lead a dedicated, multidisciplinary team where accountability is balanced with grace, professional boundaries are honored, and continuous learning is celebrated.
* **Deeply Supported Infrastructure:** Backed by an executive team, a committed board, pro bono legal partners, and local volunteer networks, you will have the structural stability and community resources required to deliver high\-quality, high\-standards of care.
* **A Serene Setting for Healing:** Your daily work environment takes place in a setting of immense natural beauty, offering a peaceful, restorative regulating backdrop that supports both your staff's well\-being and the residents' path to joy.

**Restorative Care Program Director** 

**POSITION SUMMARY:** Development, management and coordination of EdenSpring programs. This includes the supervision, development, and management of staff who deliver direct services to adult residents, as well as active participation in community education efforts. Key direct reports include Home Coordinators and the Intake Coordinator/Case Manager. The Program Director is expected to intentionally model EdenSpring values—Love First, Offer Grace, Value Excellence, Exercise Integrity, and Walk Together—in every interaction with residents, staff, partners, and the community.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Program Oversight \& Clinical Excellence**

Design and implement trauma\- and survivor\-informed structured, therapeutic programming.

* Develop comprehensive program components that are research based, codified and supported by robust staff and participant manuals.
* Build balanced, predictable daily and weekly program schedules that support resident stability and healing.
* Develop evidence\-based program content and select impactful, trauma\-informed program modules.

Cultivate strategic care networks

* Build strong, collaborative relationships with trusted program providers and vital community partners.

Deliver high\-quality, trauma\- and survivor\-informed residential services.

* Provide holistic oversight, supervision, and quality assurance for all adult female resident services.
* Collaborate with staff, residents, and external providers to create, review, and refine individual treatment plans.
* Review case notes and written correspondence to ensure documentation meets legal, ethical, and organizational standards.
* Maintain exact record\-keeping and database data entry to ensure compliance with county, state, and federal regulations.

Lead program evaluation and alignment.

* Partner with the CEO to set strategic program goals and execute rigorous program evaluations.
* Stay informed of emerging trends, research, and training opportunities regarding human trafficking.
* Infuse continuous learning, curiosity, and evidence\-based survivor practices into daily operations.
* Keep the CEO and Board of Directors informed of programmatic successes, personnel developments, and participant progress.

**Staff Leadership \& Values Modeling**

Supervise and develop direct service staff.

* Model EdenSpring values in all interactions to cultivate a culture of grace, truth, and mutual respect.
* Facilitate regular one\-on\-one meetings to support staff well\-being, professional growth, and accountability.

The **Operations Director** supports the growth of Hyper Solutions by identifying and building a strong manufacturing partnership network and leading multifunctional teams to ensure customer needs and expectations are met within a contract manufacturing environment.


This position is responsible for defining manufacturing standards, production specifications, control processes, procedures, and product requirements for Hyper’s manufacturing partners. The Operations Director also ensures incoming supplies meet quality standards, establishes acceptable levels of variation, and monitors the quality performance of manufacturing partners.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Identify and establish manufacturing and supply partnerships that support Hyper Solutions’ growth plans.
* Oversee manufacturing operations and related functions to ensure strategic and operating objectives are met.
* Identify and target areas in which the business can improve its operations.
* Develop and monitor revenue margins, operating expenses, and budgets in partnership with the Chief Operating Officer.
* Drive the planning and orchestration of business objectives.
* Serve as a subject matter expert in process improvement, organizational design, and management and measurement systems.
* Deploy and implement the Hyper Operational Excellence System through internal and external partnerships.
* Research and implement new directives that support business growth and prosperity.
* Lead strategic initiatives to improve scalability, agility, and efficiency.
* Implement methods to inspect, test, and evaluate the reliability of manufacturing processes, products, and production equipment.
* Ensure processes adhere to quality standards defined by Hyper Solutions.
* Prepare reports by collecting, analyzing, and summarizing operational data.
* Deploy leadership systems and management processes to support on\-time product delivery.
* Drive cross\-functional alignment to ensure manufacturing partners meet customer and product quality expectations.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Hire, develop, and manage a team of professionals.
* Develop and implement guidelines for employee evaluation, recruitment, and promotion.
* Oversee employee productivity, training, and personal and career growth.
* Support new product development activities and the creation of new product standard operating procedures.
* Support the company’s strategic planning process.
* Lead the Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality functions.
* Promote a strong safety culture across Hyper Solutions and its manufacturing partners.
* Perform other duties as assigned.


Requirements:
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, Finance, Computer Science, or a related field.
* Minimum of 5 years of related leadership experience, including experience managing third\-party or contract manufacturing operations.
* Prior experience as an Operations Director, Operations Manager, or in a comparable operations leadership role.
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets.
* Experience leading continuous improvement activities using Lean Manufacturing and 5S methodologies where appropriate.
* Expertise with ERP and MRP systems.
* Ability to read and understand blueprints and schematics.
* Electrical testing knowledge or experience.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and organizational skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to work effectively in a fast\-paced professional environment, including in a remote work setting.
* Ability to lead focused team activities involving third\-party partners and work with a high sense of urgency.
* Ability to adapt to frequent change, delays, and unexpected events while maintaining professionalism and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* MBA or other relevant advanced degree.
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification.
* Experience with ISO\-based quality management systems.
* Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing tools, including error proofing, PFMEAs, and 5S practices.
* Experience with SolidWorks, Arena, Oracle, or comparable systems.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A reliable manufacturing and supply partner network is in place to support Hyper Solutions’ growth plans.
* Manufacturing partners consistently meet Hyper’s expectations for product quality and on\-time delivery.
* Operational standards, production specifications, control processes, and management systems are clearly defined and consistently applied.
* Continuous improvement initiatives strengthen scalability, agility, efficiency, and overall operational performance.
* Manufacturing, Supply Chain, and Quality teams operate with strong accountability, alignment, and visibility into performance.

**Why Hyper?**


At Hyper, you’ll play a critical role in building and strengthening the manufacturing network and operational systems that support a rapidly growing technology and manufacturing organization. You’ll work across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Quality, and external partner teams to help Hyper deliver mission\-critical power and infrastructure solutions with consistency, quality, and speed.

**Compensation**


The anticipated minimum hiring range for this role is $160,000 – $180,000 year plus bonus. Actual salary varies due to factors that may include, but are not limited to, relevant experience, skills, certifications, and location. This hire will be eligible for discretionary bonus or incentive compensation. Variable compensation may depend on various factors, such as individual and organizational performance.


In addition to competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits, including employer\-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage and a 401(k) with company match, Hyper offers opportunities for professional development, career growth, and advancement as the company continues to expand.

Description:
**Benefits**

* Low\-cost medical, dental, and vision coverage. Health savings account. 403b retirement plan with employer match (50% match up to 3%).
* Employee Assistance Program for all employees
* 33 paid days off: 11 observed paid holidays, 12 sick days, and 10 vacation days to start. Vacation increases to 12 days after 1 year, 15 days after 2 years, and more at 5 and 9 years of service
	+ Sick and vacation time accrue hourly per pay period
* $50,000 in employer\-paid life insurance; additional coverage available
* Employer contribution to your Health Savings Account (paid quarterly)
* Employee Referral Program including cash bonuses and paid time off

**About**


Volunteers of America, Utah is an affiliate of a national, nonprofit, faith\-based organization that has served communities across the United States for more than 125 years. Volunteers of America, Utah’s mission is to provide community\-supported pathways for those who are vulnerable to improve their lives and increase their self\-reliance. Our programs serve people experiencing challenges related to mental health, substance use, and homelessness. We encourage all who are passionate about making a difference, including individuals with lived experience, to apply.

 **Position Summary**


The YRC Program Director provides leadership, supervision, and administrative oversight for the Youth Resource Center’s 24/7 emergency shelter and drop\-in services for youth and young adults experiencing homelessness. The Director is responsible for ensuring safe, consistent, high\-quality, and youth\-centered program operations in alignment with Volunteers of America, Utah’s mission, policies, contractual obligations, licensing requirements, and applicable federal, state, and local requirements.


The Director oversees program operations, staffing and supervision, program quality, safety and incident response, budget and grant utilization, data and reporting, policy implementation, and community partnerships. Working in collaboration with the Division Director and other agency leadership, the Director identifies service gaps, strengthens program systems, and supports the continued development of effective services for youth experiencing homelessness.

**Essential Duties**

* Provide leadership and administrative oversight for all Youth Resource Center shelter and drop\-in operations, ensuring safe, consistent, high\-quality, and youth\-centered service delivery across 24/7 operations.
* Ensure shelter and drop\-in services operate in compliance with applicable federal, state, local, contractual, licensing, accreditation, and organizational requirements.
* Oversee implementation of Trauma\-Informed Care, Positive Youth Development, Harm Reduction, and other evidence\-based or best\-practice approaches throughout shelter operations.
* Hire, train, supervise, coach, and evaluate program managers and other assigned staff, and ensure effective supervision, training, performance management, and accountability systems are maintained across shelter teams.
* Ensure appropriate staffing, scheduling, supervisory coverage, and operational continuity necessary to support safe and effective 24/7 shelter operations.
* Provide oversight of shelter safety practices, emergency response, incident reporting, client\-related concerns, and other significant operational events, ensuring appropriate documentation, follow\-up, and corrective action.
* Develop, implement, evaluate, and maintain shelter policies, procedures, workflows, and operational practices in collaboration with the Division Director and other agency leadership.
* Monitor program quality, service delivery, performance data, and client outcomes to identify trends, address service gaps, and support continuous quality improvement.
* Ensure timely, accurate, and complete program documentation, data collection, reporting, and other records required by contracts, funders, licensing entities, and the agency.
* with budget development and monitor program expenditures and appropriate utilization of grant and contract funds in collaboration with the Division Director, Finance, and program leadership.
* Ensure appropriate oversight of program purchasing, payroll processes, financial coding, receipts, and other required fiscal documentation.
* Prepare for and participate in internal and external monitoring, licensing reviews, audits, and program evaluations, and ensure identified corrective actions are implemented.
* Lead the development and implementation of shelter programming and services that respond to the needs of youth experiencing homelessness and promote connection to housing, behavioral health, education, employment, benefits, and other community resources.
* Build and maintain effective working relationships with community organizations, service providers, government partners, funders, law enforcement, emergency responders, and other partners whose work impacts YRC clients and operations.
* Create and maintain a collaborative, professional, and accountable workplace culture and model behavior consistent with the mission, values, policies, and leadership expectations of Volunteers of America, Utah.
* Respond to and resolve significant staff or client concerns, complaints, and grievances in a timely, professional, and trauma\-informed manner.
* Support agency development and community engagement efforts by providing program expertise, participating in grant development as requested, facilitating site visits and tours, and representing the YRC in community and stakeholder meetings.
* Participate in agency leadership activities, management meetings, and the Management On\-Call rotation as assigned.
* Attend work as scheduled and maintain the availability and flexibility necessary to provide leadership to a 24/7 residential program.
* Perform other duties as needed to support program effectiveness and organizational goals.
